l4Discriminating.text: Synthetic or algorithmic data generation with programmed parameters — Several statistical features are unnatural for true physical transducers: every channel exhibits identical 0.000100 quantization, drift is virtually non-existent (|z| <= 0.93 across >200 trials over 25 days), and cross-checks show an anomalous correlation of 0.647 between pendulum_lab and resonator_obs at a 3-day lag (well exceeding the ±0.265 chance threshold), despite these instruments measuring different modalities at different sites. A synthetic data generator parameterized with clean 3:2 ratios and shared pseudorandom sequences explains both the exact ratios and the cross-modal lag correlation better than physical mechanics.
